_comment: QM-0001 test floor, enforced by scripts/verify-baseline.sh. The floor may only ever be RAISED; a task that lowers it is rejected in review. Counts were measured on the commit below by running `cargo test --workspace` and `cd apps/web && npx vitest run`. Derivations for every cli_golden value are in .plan/evidence/QM-0001.md.
_commit_field_note: The _comment above says the counts were measured on `commit`, so this field is repinned in the same change that moves a count. QM-0030 measured 477/45 on f4fba1e, its implementation commit. 6fb593a ('pin baseline.json to its merge commit') shows the controller may repin this to the merge commit when the branch lands; that is a repin of a true value, not a correction of a false one. Web counts were NOT re-measured on f4fba1e beyond confirming they are unchanged at 115/13, because QM-0030 changed no web file.
_rust_floor_raised_by: QM-0121 — 677 tests over 51 binaries was the floor on base e49ac24; raised to 704 over 52 after adding the paired block reduction (`paired_block_reduction` on the `Backend` trait, `ChannelAxis`, `ChannelPartials`, `PairedPartials`, and the CpuBackend reference implementation). Exactly +27 tests: crates/q-gpu/src/paired.rs 26 unit tests, plus crates/q-gpu/tests/paired_allocation_bounds.rs 1. 677 + 27 = 704 reconciles exactly, which is also the check that no pre-existing test was removed, weakened, or #[ignore]d — q-gpu's 7 pre-existing lib tests all still run and pass (33 = 7 + 26 in that binary). The one new binary is crates/q-gpu/tests/paired_allocation_bounds.rs, which needs its own binary because it installs a counting #[global_allocator]. Derivation in .plan/evidence/QM-0121.md. Web counts are untouched at 115/13: QM-0121 changed no web file. Previously: QM-0101 — 545 tests over 45 binaries is the floor recorded on base d49701c; raised to 624 over 47 after adding the configured resident ceiling, the MEMORY_BUDGET.md §11 precedence chain, the checkpoint-level residency pass, and the `q stream` verb. Exactly +79 tests: q-source/src/config.rs 14, q-tensor-runtime/src/residency.rs 15, tests/tests/bounded_residency.rs 26, tests/tests/residency_peak_allocation.rs 1, plus q-source/src/budget.rs +3, q-source/src/local.rs +5, q-tensor-runtime/src/stream.rs +6, q-cli/src/main.rs +9. 545 + 79 = 624 reconciles exactly, which is also the check that no pre-existing test was removed, weakened, or #[ignore]d. The two new binaries are tests/tests/bounded_residency.rs and tests/tests/residency_peak_allocation.rs. Derivation in .plan/evidence/QM-0101.md. Web counts are untouched at 115/13: QM-0101 changed no web file. Previously: QM-0030 — 434 over 43 measured on base 6fb593a, raised to 477 over 45 after adding the bounded streaming block reader (crates/q-tensor-runtime/tests/bounded_residency.rs and real_fixture_blocks.rs); see .plan/evidence/QM-0030.md.
_qm_0101_measurement_note: 624/47 was measured by `cargo test --workspace` on the working tree of branch task/qm-0101-bounded-residency-proof at base d49701c, NOT on commit 703903d or on d49701c itself — base d49701c yields 545/45, which is why that is the floor these counts were checked against. `commit` is left at its previous value rather than repinned to a self-referential SHA: the counts cannot be measured on the commit that records them without an amend cycle that invalidates the SHA it just wrote. The controller repins this field at merge, exactly as 6fb593a did.
_qm_0121_measurement_note: CORRECTED AT MERGE by the controller. The note previously here asserted, in the present tense, that verify-baseline.sh FAILS the web leg and that npm package three is absent. Both were true when written and are FALSE at this merge: the controller repaired the environment with npm install in apps/web (no lockfile churn), and the web gate now measures 13 files / 115 tests, guard exit 0. Both independent reviewers flagged that a false claim about a gate, living inside that gate own definition file, is a ready-made excuse for a future agent to dismiss a real failure. The floors were correctly NEVER lowered to the 111 measured under the broken environment.
_qm_0121_differential_verification_note: RAISED AGAIN, 704/52 -> 715/53, by the differential-verification half of QM-0121: crates/q-gpu/tests/paired_reference_goldens.rs, 11 tests in 1 new binary, checking the paired reduction against the independent NumPy reference python/reference/paired_reduction_reference.py. 704 + 11 = 715 and 52 + 1 = 53 reconcile exactly, which is also the check that no pre-existing test was removed, weakened, or #[ignore]d. Measured by `cargo test --workspace` on the working tree of branch task/qm-0121-metric-kernels at head 988d4c6 plus that one test binary: exit 0, 715 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored, over 53 binaries. `commit` was subsequently repinned by impl-agent-7 to 131d102, the first commit whose OWN tree measures the 715/53 recorded here (verified: `cargo test --workspace` on a clean detached worktree at 131d102, exit 0, 715 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored, over 53 binaries). 988d4c6 remains a real ancestor a reviewer can check out, and yields 704/52 on its own — 715/53 once this binary is present. Web counts are untouched at 115/13: this change touched no web file. TWO AGENTS worked QM-0121 concurrently in one worktree — the implementation half recorded 704/52 in .plan/evidence/QM-0121.md and anticipated exactly this re-measurement; the verification half is recorded in .plan/evidence/QM-0121-differential-verification.md. The controller reconciles at merge. Two other branches are raising this floor concurrently.
_cli_golden_provenance: No expected value below was produced by q-cli. Tensor, shard and payload counts and the exact scalar come from fixtures/tiny-llama-2shard/golden.json, generated by Python safetensors==0.8.0. Layer rows and the planned matmul shape are arithmetic over the fixture's own config.json. Block statistics were computed from golden.json's f32 bit patterns. Each value is matched as a substring of the command's whitespace-squeezed stdout.
